title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: There's no cap on how much you can spend or how many refunds you can get, but whether I can refund a purchase myself depends on the purchase. In this chat I can refund a settled card purchase of $75 or less that's under 30 days old, refunding the full amount. Bigger or older purchases, and money sent to another person, go to our support team to review, so for a large purchase a person would decide on the refund.
